description: You can use dictionary membership to choose a safe branch.

steps.description: You create a menu with coffee, bagel and muffin as keys. pizza is absent from this dictionary.

steps.answer: No. The membership test is False, so execution goes to else before that lookup.
steps.question: Will the program execute the lookup menu['pizza']?

steps.description: You see Sorry, we don't sell pizza. The message comes from the branch for the missing key.
The final membership test checks coffee, which is a key in menu. You see True after the pizza message.

title: Checking a key before lookup
